edges: The Blue Jays would encroach on another bird's nest.
Blue Jays are often misunderstood to take over other birds' nests.
Blue Jays do not take over other birds' nests.
The dedication of blue jays to creation is evidence against the false claim that they take over other birds' nests.
The Blue Jays consistently construct their nests, showing a strong tendency to do so even when opportunities to take over others' nests are present.
